caption: The drawing depicts a botanical object consisting of two short cylindrical sections and one long, narrow, and slightly curved section all attached together. The objects are light to medium brown in color with a textured, segmented surface, resembling the appearance of some types of plant stems or pods. The composition is centered on a plain, off-white background with no other objects or details present. The three sections are arranged vertically, with the two shorter sections standing parallel and closely beside each other at the base, and the longer section rising from the right of the base and curving outward. There is a small, faint signature or inscription below the base of the objects.
title: Corn-cob Pipe
